Slide, combine, and build your biggest number.
Swipe the board or use arrow keys to merge equal tiles. Press U or tap Undo to take back a move — new best tiles from 128 up earn more undos.
Build glowing rows before the well fills.
Arrows move and turn, Space drops, C holds. On touch: drag to move, tap to turn, flick down to drop.
Guide a growing neon trail through a tiny starfield.
Swipe or use arrow keys to eat sparks; avoid your own trail.
A compact field of risky crystals.
Tap to reveal. Hold a cell or right-click to plant a flag.
A calm original Klondike table with midnight cards.
Tap a face-up card, then a destination column or foundation.
A quiet, focused number grid with gentle feedback.
Select a square, then tap a number or use your keyboard.
Trace hidden words through a glowing letter trail.
Drag through adjacent letters to spell every word.
Turn over starlit cards and find every twin.
Tap cards to reveal pairs. Match them all in as few turns as possible.
Catch a moving neon slab exactly over your tower.
Tap or press Space to drop each moving block.
A tiny comet bird races through the twilight gates.
Tap the stage or press Space to flap through each gap.
A luminous brick breaker with escalating pulse rows.
Drag the paddle or use arrow keys; clear every brick.
Defend the signal beacon from advancing pixel swarms.
Move with arrows or drag; tap or Space fires.
Sprint the glowing rails as traffic closes in.
Swipe lanes, swipe up to jump, down to slide; arrows also work.
Navigate a tiny temple whose floor has opinions.
Use arrows or touch sides to move; tap upper screen to jump.
Balance a tiny rover over a hand-drawn test track.
Hold DRIVE to climb and BRAKE to slow; use left and right keys too.
Drop orbiting fruit and grow them into stellar giants.
Drag to aim and release to drop; arrows and Space work too. Match two alike to grow them.
Aim charged bubbles into matching clusters.
Drag from the launcher and release to shoot; arrows and Space also work.
Fit shifting hex fragments and clear radiant axes.
Tap a tray piece, then a board cell; use 1–3, arrows, and Space.
Thread throws through a spinning neon core.
Tap or press Space to throw; avoid knives already embedded.
Lead a lone spear general through four battlegrounds, evolve five weapons and defeat the Warlord at 5:00.
Move with WASD, arrows, drag, or the virtual stick. Attacks are automatic; pick an upgrade each level. Space or Attack fires your Burst when it is charged.
Name capitals, flags and country outlines from every continent.

Pick a mode: capitals, flags, outlines or the mixed World tour. Tap the right answer out of four; answer in a row for a streak bonus. Every country you get right joins your atlas, and missed ones come back sooner.
Twenty stages. Twenty guardians. Five acts to reclaim the sun. Choose Easy, Normal or Hard; chain kills, forge upgrades and resume your campaign.

Choose an act, stage and difficulty, then Start. Runs continue through Level XX; Resume restores the next saved stage. Choose a forge blessing after each boss. Build heat with hits for Overdrive. A/D move, W or Space jump, J slash (tap for a 3-hit combo), K shotgun, L or Shift roll, R reload. Touch buttons on mobile.
Slash, shoot, roll, reclaim the sun
Thirteen playful levels that teach a child every button, stick and trigger on a real game controller.

Plug in a controller and press any button; a Twin USB 2-in-1 receiver needs the Connect button in Chrome or Edge. The glowing part of the on-screen pad and a helping hand show what to press. Keyboard: WASD or arrows move, TFGH right stick, I J K L buttons, Q E shoulders, Z C triggers. You can also tap the on-screen pad; on a phone, play in full screen and hold it sideways. Nobody loses: mistakes only cost stars, and every three stars earn a sticker. Three difficulties, plus a two-player Tug of War (second player: a second controller, or the arrow keys).
Learn every button, level by level
Tank warfare for one or two: Co-op Eagle Base defense with an AI ally, 5-win Versus duels, four distinct tank chassis, warp portals, and chain-reaction barrels.

Pick Co-op Defense (guard the Eagle Base across 6 stages and 2 bosses, then harder laps) or Versus Duel (first to 5 rounds), with 1 player + AI ally, solo, or 2 players. Four tank classes. P1: WASD move, Space/J fire, K/F mine, L/G dash, P pause. P2: Arrows move, Enter/0 fire, Right Shift/. mine, comma or apostrophe dash. With one player both key sets drive your tank. Supports two gamepads (A fire, X mine, B dash) and touch (stick, FIRE, MINE, DASH).
A silly couch tank brawl: bouncing shells, knockback into lava, power-up ducks, a new twist every round, and one more hat for every loss.

Versus or co-op, two players or one against a bot ladder (beat Hard to unlock the Boss). P1: WASD, F or Space fires, G dashes. P2: arrows, K or Enter fires, L dashes. Controllers and touch work too; on a phone, turn it sideways. Dash jumps pits and rams tanks; your own shells bounce back and hurt.
Pedal a breezy pelican along four coasts, from dawn beach to storm reef, hopping, gliding and sprinting to each lighthouse.
A/D or Arrows ride; Space/W/Up hops, press again to flap, hold to glide. Shift sprints. Find 3 stars per stage and beat the par time for medals.
Pedal, flap jump, glide and dash
